title: LOOK: Sara Duterte prays for peace, safety during Catbalogan church visit
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte shared photos on Sunday of her recent visit to the Our Lady of the Rosary Parish Church in Catbalogan City, Samar, where she prayed for national peace and the safety of…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte shared photos on Sunday of her recent visit to the Our Lady of the Rosary Parish Church in Catbalogan City, Samar, where she prayed for national peace and the safety of Filipinos.
In a social media post, Duterte expressed her gratitude at having been able to return to the church last month, noting she had first visited it last year during Visita Iglesia.

“Ipinalangin natin ang kaayusan at kapayapaan ng ating bansa, gayundin ang kaligtasan ng bawat isa sa atin, kabilang na ang ating mga kababayang nagtatrabaho sa ibang bansa,” the Vice President wrote in her post.
(We prayed for the order and peace of our country, as well as the safety of every one of us, including our fellow countrymen working abroad.)

“Mga kababayan, sa ating araw-araw na pamumuhay, huwag nating kalimutang magpasalamat sa Panginoon para sa lahat ng biyaya, mga makabuluhang aral sa buhay, at mga pagkakataong makasama ang ating mga mahal sa buhay,” she added.
(My fellow Filipinos, in our daily lives, let us not forget to thank the Lord for all the blessings, meaningful life lessons, and opportunities to be with our loved ones.)
Duterte is currently facing an impeachment trial before the Senate impeachment court.

Duterte's defense panel is currently presenting evidence to counter Article 2 of the impeachment complaint, which accuses her of betrayal of public trust and culpable violation of the Constitution over alleged unexplained wealth amounting to P817 million to P1.5 billion, stemming from the alleged non-declaration of assets and failure to divest from businesses despite a constitutional prohibition. –Lyjah Tiffany Bonzo/KG, GMA News
